'''Yuriko Yamaguchi''' (Japanese: '''山口由里子''' ''Yamaguchi Yuriko'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

== Biography ==
Yamaguchi was born on November 21, 1965 in {{wp|Osaka}}, {{wp|Japan}}. She began to provide voices for {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}, starting with [[EP239]], where she voiced {{p|Vileplume}}. She then gained the role of [[Nurse Joy]] in [[EP245]], taking over the role from [[Ayako Shiraishi]]. She later went on maternity leave from [[DP025]] to [[DP050]], during which [[Kikuko Inoue]] filled in. While [[Chika Fujimura]] took over the role of Nurse Joy in [[Unova]], Yamaguchi reprised the role in {{aniseries|DP}} special [[DPS02]].
